description: A React component class 'LogList' for displaying, sorting, filtering, and paginating log entries in an admin console interface, including modal display for full log details.

classes.name: LogList
classes.description: React component for rendering a log list with sorting, filtering, pagination, and modal details.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Checks if search term or filters are active.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of logs.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of logs.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines table columns with sortable timestamp.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates table rows with log data.

methods.name: showFullLogEvent
methods.description: Displays modal with full log details.

methods.name: showErrors
methods.description: Filters logs to show only errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component including data grid and modal.
